en: A colorized historic postcard showing a round medieval stone tower with a conical roof rising above trees and a wooden fence in the foreground. The tower has small rectangular windows and weathered masonry. At the top of the image the caption reads "Kik in de Kök," and beneath the picture the location is labeled "Reval." The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century printed postcard.
